sentences.text: Rudi menabung berbulan-bulan untuk membeli alat rontgen bekas bagi kliniknya.
sentences.en: Rudi saved for months to buy a used X-ray machine for his clinic.
sentences.ko: 루디는 병원에 쓸 중고 엑스레이 기계를 사려고 몇 달 동안 돈을 모았어요.

sentences.text: Rina menabung dari hasil menjual sayur untuk membeli sepatu sekolah.
sentences.en: Rina saves money from selling vegetables to buy school shoes.
sentences.ko: 리나는 채소를 판 돈을 모아 학교 신발을 사려고 해요.

sentences.text: Seekor anak kucing menarik anting pemiliknya saat diperiksa Rudi.
sentences.en: A kitten tugged at its owner's earring while Rudi was examining it.
sentences.ko: 루디가 진찰하는 동안 새끼 고양이가 주인의 귀걸이를 잡아당겼어요.

sentences.text: Nenek Rina memberinya anting perak warisan keluarga.
sentences.en: Rina's grandmother gave her silver earrings that are a family heirloom.
sentences.ko: 리나의 할머니는 집안 대대로 내려온 은귀걸이를 리나에게 줬어요.

sentences.text: Rudi meminta pemilik anjing itu tidak mengisap cerutu di ruang tunggu.
sentences.en: Rudi asked the dog owner not to smoke a cigar in the waiting room.
sentences.ko: 루디는 개 주인에게 대기실에서 시가를 피우지 말라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Kakek Rina suka duduk di beranda sambil mengisap cerutu daun jagung.
sentences.en: Rina's grandfather likes to sit on the porch smoking a corn-husk cigar.
sentences.ko: 리나의 할아버지는 옥수수 잎 시가를 피우며 툇마루에 앉아 있는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Burung beo itu suka bertengger di pundak Rudi selama pemeriksaan.
sentences.en: The parrot likes to perch on Rudi's shoulder during the checkup.
sentences.ko: 그 앵무새는 진찰하는 동안 루디의 어깨에 앉아 있는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Rina memikul keranjang kayu bakar di pundak saat menuruni bukit.
sentences.en: Rina carried a basket of firewood on her shoulder as she went down the hill.
sentences.ko: 리나는 땔감 바구니를 어깨에 메고 언덕을 내려갔어요.

sentences.text: Setelah operasi kaki, anjing itu menjalani rehabilitasi di klinik Rudi.
sentences.en: After leg surgery, the dog went through rehabilitation at Rudi's clinic.
sentences.ko: 다리 수술 후 그 개는 루디의 병원에서 재활을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Paman Rina menjalani rehabilitasi setelah jatuh dari pohon cengkih.
sentences.en: Rina's uncle went through rehabilitation after falling from a clove tree.
sentences.ko: 리나의 삼촌은 정향나무에서 떨어진 뒤 재활 치료를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Rudi tertawa melihat kucing yang punya bulu hitam seperti alis di atas matanya.
sentences.en: Rudi laughed at the cat that had black fur like eyebrows above its eyes.
sentences.ko: 루디는 눈 위에 눈썹 같은 검은 털이 난 고양이를 보고 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Ibu Rina merapikan alis sebelum berangkat ke pesta panen.
sentences.en: Rina's mother tidied her eyebrows before leaving for the harvest festival.
sentences.ko: 리나의 엄마는 추수 잔치에 가기 전에 눈썹을 다듬었어요.

sentences.text: Klinik Rudi punya bangsal kecil untuk hewan yang harus dirawat inap.
sentences.en: Rudi's clinic has a small ward for animals that need to stay overnight.
sentences.ko: 루디의 병원에는 입원해야 하는 동물을 위한 작은 병실이 있어요.

sentences.text: Puskesmas di desa Rina hanya punya satu bangsal untuk pasien rawat inap.
sentences.en: The health center in Rina's village has only one ward for inpatients.
sentences.ko: 리나네 마을 보건소에는 입원 환자용 병실이 하나뿐이에요.

sentences.text: Rudi dibantu seorang paramedis veteriner yang sudah berpengalaman.
sentences.en: Rudi is assisted by an experienced veterinary paramedic.
sentences.ko: 루디는 경험 많은 수의 보조원의 도움을 받아요.

sentences.text: Rina bercita-cita menjadi paramedis supaya bisa menolong warga desanya.
sentences.en: Rina dreams of becoming a paramedic so she can help her villagers.
sentences.ko: 리나는 마을 사람들을 도울 수 있게 응급구조사가 되고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Rudi tidak meminta sepeser pun dari nenek yang membawa kucing liar terluka.
sentences.en: Rudi didn't ask a single cent from the grandmother who brought in an injured stray cat.
sentences.ko: 루디는 다친 길고양이를 데려온 할머니에게 한 푼도 받지 않았어요.

sentences.text: Rina tidak punya uang sepeser pun saat ketinggalan angkot terakhir.
sentences.en: Rina didn't have a single cent when she missed the last minibus.
sentences.ko: 리나는 마지막 미니버스를 놓쳤을 때 돈이 한 푼도 없었어요.

sentences.text: Anjing tua itu berjalan pincang karena sendinya meradang, jelas Rudi.
sentences.en: The old dog walks with a limp because its joints are inflamed, Rudi explained.
sentences.ko: 늙은 개가 관절에 염증이 있어서 절뚝거린다고 루디가 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Kambing milik Rina jalannya pincang setelah tersandung batu.
sentences.en: Rina's goat has been walking with a limp since it tripped on a rock.
sentences.ko: 리나의 염소는 돌에 걸려 넘어진 뒤로 절뚝거리며 걸어요.

sentences.text: Rudi memberi obat pereda nyeri kepada kuda yang kakinya bengkak.
sentences.en: Rudi gave pain relief to the horse with a swollen leg.
sentences.ko: 루디는 다리가 부은 말에게 진통제를 줬어요.

sentences.text: Rina merasakan nyeri di lutut setelah mendaki jalan setapak yang curam.
sentences.en: Rina felt pain in her knee after climbing the steep footpath.
sentences.ko: 리나는 가파른 오솔길을 오른 뒤 무릎에 통증을 느꼈어요.

sentences.text: Para pemilik hewan di kota itu menganggap Rudi sebagai penyembuh yang sabar.
sentences.en: Pet owners in that town see Rudi as a patient healer.
sentences.ko: 그 도시의 반려동물 주인들은 루디를 참을성 있는 치료사로 여겨요.

sentences.text: Warga desa Rina masih percaya pada penyembuh tradisional di lereng gunung.
sentences.en: Rina's villagers still believe in the traditional healer on the mountain slope.
sentences.ko: 리나네 마을 사람들은 아직도 산비탈의 전통 치료사를 믿어요.

sentences.text: Rudi butuh hasil tes darah sebelum mendiagnosis penyakit kelinci itu.
sentences.en: Rudi needs the blood test results before diagnosing the rabbit's illness.
sentences.ko: 루디는 토끼의 병을 진단하기 전에 혈액 검사 결과가 필요해요.

sentences.text: Dokter dari kota datang untuk mendiagnosis penyakit kulit yang dialami anak-anak desa Rina.
sentences.en: A doctor from the city came to diagnose the skin disease affecting children in Rina's village.
sentences.ko: 도시에서 온 의사가 리나네 마을 아이들의 피부병을 진단하러 왔어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menyuntikkan adrenalin ketika jantung anjing kecil itu melemah.
sentences.en: Rudi injected adrenaline when the little dog's heart weakened.
sentences.ko: 작은 개의 심장이 약해지자 루디는 아드레날린을 주사했어요.

sentences.text: Rina merasakan adrenalin mengalir saat menyeberangi jembatan gantung.
sentences.en: Rina felt the adrenaline rush as she crossed the suspension bridge.
sentences.ko: 리나는 출렁다리를 건너며 아드레날린이 솟는 걸 느꼈어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menyuruh pemilik membawa anjing yang kepanasan itu ke ruangan ber-AC.
sentences.en: Rudi told the owner to bring the overheated dog into the air-conditioned room.
sentences.ko: 루디는 더위 먹은 개를 에어컨 있는 방으로 데려오라고 주인에게 말했어요.

sentences.text: Turis dari kota tampak kepanasan meski udara di desa Rina sejuk.
sentences.en: The tourists from the city looked overheated even though the air in Rina's village was cool.
sentences.ko: 리나네 마을 공기가 서늘한데도 도시에서 온 관광객들은 더워 보였어요.

sentences.text: Pasangan muda itu datang ke klinik Rudi dengan kaus serasi bergambar kucing.
sentences.en: The young couple came to Rudi's clinic in matching cat T-shirts.
sentences.ko: 그 젊은 부부는 고양이 그림이 있는 커플 티셔츠를 입고 루디의 병원에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Rina memakai kebaya yang serasi dengan selendang ibunya saat pesta panen.
sentences.en: Rina wore a kebaya that matched her mother's shawl at the harvest festival.
sentences.ko: 리나는 추수 잔치에 엄마의 숄과 어울리는 끄바야를 입었어요.

sentences.text: Rudi tersenyum melihat dua ekor merpati bercumbu di atap klinik.
sentences.en: Rudi smiled at two doves billing and cooing on the clinic roof.
sentences.ko: 루디는 병원 지붕에서 비둘기 두 마리가 사랑을 나누는 걸 보고 미소 지었어요.

sentences.text: Rina menunjuk sepasang burung yang bercumbu di dahan pohon cemara.
sentences.en: Rina pointed to a pair of birds courting on a pine branch.
sentences.ko: 리나는 소나무 가지에서 구애하는 새 한 쌍을 가리켰어요.

sentences.text: Kucing itu terus mengelak setiap kali Rudi mencoba memberinya obat.
sentences.en: The cat kept dodging every time Rudi tried to give it medicine.
sentences.ko: 루디가 약을 먹이려 할 때마다 고양이는 계속 피했어요.

sentences.text: Adik Rina selalu mengelak saat ditanya siapa yang memetik stroberi di kebun.
sentences.en: Rina's little brother always dodges the question of who picked the strawberries in the garden.
sentences.ko: 리나의 동생은 밭에서 누가 딸기를 땄냐고 물으면 늘 말을 돌려요.

sentences.text: Program vaksinasi gratis Rudi bertujuan melindungi hewan liar di kampung.
sentences.en: Rudi's free vaccination program aims to protect stray animals in the village.
sentences.ko: 루디의 무료 예방접종 사업은 마을의 떠돌이 동물을 보호하는 게 목적이에요.

sentences.text: Rina ikut kelompok pemuda yang bertujuan menanam kembali hutan di lereng.
sentences.en: Rina joined a youth group that aims to replant the forest on the slopes.
sentences.ko: 리나는 비탈의 숲을 다시 가꾸려는 청년 모임에 들어갔어요.

sentences.text: Anjing itu tidak berhenti menggaruk telinganya, jadi Rudi memeriksa kutunya.
sentences.en: The dog wouldn't stop scratching its ear, so Rudi checked it for fleas.
sentences.ko: 개가 귀를 계속 긁어서 루디는 벼룩이 있는지 살펴봤어요.

sentences.text: Rina menggaruk lengannya yang digigit serangga di kebun teh.
sentences.en: Rina scratched her arm where an insect had bitten her in the tea garden.
sentences.ko: 리나는 차밭에서 벌레에 물린 팔을 긁었어요.

sentences.text: Seekor angsa galak menghadang Rudi di halaman peternakan.
sentences.en: A fierce goose blocked Rudi's way in the farmyard.
sentences.ko: 사나운 거위 한 마리가 농장 마당에서 루디의 앞을 막아섰어요.

sentences.text: Kabut tebal menghadang langkah Rina di jalan menuju sekolah.
sentences.en: Thick fog blocked Rina's way on the road to school.
sentences.ko: 짙은 안개가 학교 가는 길에서 리나의 앞을 가로막았어요.

sentences.text: Rudi memperbarui catatan vaksin semua pasiennya setiap bulan.
sentences.en: Rudi updates the vaccination records of all his patients every month.
sentences.ko: 루디는 매달 모든 환자의 예방접종 기록을 갱신해요.

sentences.text: Rina membantu ayahnya memperbarui atap ijuk rumah mereka.
sentences.en: Rina helped her father renew the palm-fiber roof of their house.
sentences.ko: 리나는 아빠를 도와 집의 야자섬유 지붕을 새로 이었어요.

sentences.text: Anak anjing itu mengompol di meja periksa karena takut pada Rudi.
sentences.en: The puppy wet itself on the exam table because it was scared of Rudi.
sentences.ko: 강아지가 루디를 무서워해서 진찰대 위에 오줌을 쌌어요.

sentences.text: Adik bungsu Rina masih suka mengompol kalau malamnya terlalu dingin.
sentences.en: Rina's youngest sibling still tends to wet the bed when the night is too cold.
sentences.ko: 리나의 막내 동생은 밤이 너무 추우면 아직도 이불에 오줌을 싸요.

sentences.text: Rudi memfoto luka di kaki kambing untuk dikirim ke rekan dokternya.
sentences.en: Rudi photographed the wound on the goat's leg to send to a fellow vet.
sentences.ko: 루디는 동료 수의사에게 보내려고 염소 다리의 상처를 사진으로 찍었어요.

sentences.text: Rina memfoto matahari terbit dari puncak bukit dekat desanya.
sentences.en: Rina photographed the sunrise from the hilltop near her village.
sentences.ko: 리나는 마을 근처 언덕 꼭대기에서 해돋이를 찍었어요.

sentences.text: Dalam film yang ditonton Rudi, seorang suami menceraikan istrinya demi warisan seekor kuda pacu.
sentences.en: In the film Rudi watched, a husband divorces his wife over the inheritance of a racehorse.
sentences.ko: 루디가 본 영화에서 한 남편은 경주마 유산 때문에 아내와 이혼해요.

sentences.text: Dalam cerita rakyat yang diceritakan nenek Rina, seorang raja menceraikan permaisurinya karena fitnah.
sentences.en: In the folk tale Rina's grandmother tells, a king divorces his queen because of slander.
sentences.ko: 리나의 할머니가 들려주는 민담에서 한 왕은 모함 때문에 왕비와 이혼해요.

sentences.text: Rudi melihat seekor rusa melintas di jalan saat pulang dari peternakan.
sentences.en: Rudi saw a deer cross the road on his way back from the farm.
sentences.ko: 루디는 농장에서 돌아오는 길에 사슴 한 마리가 길을 건너는 걸 봤어요.

sentences.text: Rina melambai setiap kali truk sayur melintas di depan rumahnya.
sentences.en: Rina waves every time the vegetable truck passes in front of her house.
sentences.ko: 리나는 채소 트럭이 집 앞을 지나갈 때마다 손을 흔들어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menemukan kelainan pada detak jantung kucing persia itu.
sentences.en: Rudi found an irregularity in the Persian cat's heartbeat.
sentences.ko: 루디는 페르시안 고양이의 심장 박동에서 이상을 발견했어요.

sentences.text: Bidan desa memeriksa apakah bayi tetangga Rina punya kelainan jantung.
sentences.en: The village midwife checked whether Rina's neighbor's baby had a heart defect.
sentences.ko: 마을 산파는 리나네 이웃 아기에게 심장 이상이 있는지 살펴봤어요.

sentences.text: Rudi marah mendengar berita perlakuan biadab terhadap hewan di sebuah pasar.
sentences.en: Rudi was angry to hear news of brutal treatment of animals at a market.
sentences.ko: 루디는 한 시장에서 동물을 잔혹하게 다뤘다는 뉴스를 듣고 화가 났어요.

sentences.text: Guru sejarah Rina bercerita tentang penjajah biadab yang membakar desa-desa.
sentences.en: Rina's history teacher told of brutal colonizers who burned villages.
sentences.ko: 리나의 역사 선생님은 마을을 불태운 잔혹한 침략자들에 대해 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Kucing yang tertabrak motor itu selamat berkat operasi cepat Rudi.
sentences.en: The cat that was hit by a motorbike survived thanks to Rudi's quick surgery.
sentences.ko: 오토바이에 치인 고양이는 루디의 빠른 수술 덕분에 살았어요.

sentences.text: Ayam Rina hampir tertabrak sepeda motor tukang sayur pagi tadi.
sentences.en: Rina's chicken was almost hit by the vegetable seller's motorbike this morning.
sentences.ko: 오늘 아침 리나의 닭이 채소 장수 오토바이에 치일 뻔했어요.

sentences.text: Kucing kecil itu tertidur di pangkuan Rudi setelah diberi suntikan.
sentences.en: The little cat fell asleep on Rudi's lap after getting its shot.
sentences.ko: 작은 고양이는 주사를 맞고 루디의 무릎에서 잠들었어요.

sentences.text: Adik Rina tertidur di pangkuan nenek sambil mendengar dongeng.
sentences.en: Rina's little sister fell asleep on her grandmother's lap listening to a story.
sentences.ko: 리나의 동생은 옛날이야기를 듣다가 할머니 무릎에서 잠들었어요.

sentences.text: Rudi mengeluarkan serpihan kaca dari telapak kaki anjing itu.
sentences.en: Rudi removed a shard of glass from the dog's paw.
sentences.ko: 루디는 개의 발바닥에서 유리 조각을 빼냈어요.

sentences.text: Rina menyapu serpihan genteng yang jatuh karena angin kencang.
sentences.en: Rina swept up pieces of roof tile that had fallen in the strong wind.
sentences.ko: 리나는 강풍에 떨어진 기와 조각을 쓸어 냈어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menyalurkan makanan sumbangan warga ke tempat penampungan hewan.
sentences.en: Rudi distributes food donated by residents to the animal shelter.
sentences.ko: 루디는 주민들이 기부한 사료를 동물 보호소에 전달해요.

sentences.text: Kepala desa menyalurkan bantuan beras kepada keluarga Rina setelah longsor.
sentences.en: The village head distributed rice aid to Rina's family after the landslide.
sentences.ko: 산사태 뒤 이장님이 리나네 가족에게 쌀 지원을 전달했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi senang karena kebutuhan obat kliniknya akhirnya terpenuhi.
sentences.en: Rudi is happy because his clinic's medicine needs have finally been met.
sentences.ko: 루디는 병원에 필요한 약이 마침내 다 갖춰져서 기뻐요.

sentences.text: Kebutuhan air bersih di desa Rina akhirnya terpenuhi berkat pipa baru.
sentences.en: Clean water needs in Rina's village were finally met thanks to a new pipe.
sentences.ko: 새 수도관 덕분에 리나네 마을의 깨끗한 물 문제가 마침내 해결됐어요.

sentences.text: Rudi memesan salep khusus dari bagian farmasi rumah sakit hewan pusat.
sentences.en: Rudi ordered a special ointment from the central animal hospital's pharmacy.
sentences.ko: 루디는 중앙 동물병원 약제부에 특별한 연고를 주문했어요.

sentences.text: Rina ingin kuliah di jurusan farmasi agar bisa membuka apotek di desa.
sentences.en: Rina wants to study pharmacy so she can open a drugstore in the village.
sentences.ko: 리나는 마을에 약국을 열려고 약학과에 가고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menjelaskan bahwa morfin hanya dipakai untuk hewan yang sangat kesakitan.
sentences.en: Rudi explained that morphine is only used for animals in severe pain.
sentences.ko: 루디는 모르핀이 아주 심하게 아픈 동물에게만 쓰인다고 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Dokter puskesmas menjelaskan kepada Rina bahwa morfin hanya diberikan di rumah sakit besar.
sentences.en: The health-center doctor explained to Rina that morphine is only given at big hospitals.
sentences.ko: 보건소 의사는 리나에게 모르핀은 큰 병원에서만 준다고 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi membaca jurnal tentang transplantasi ginjal pada kucing.
sentences.en: Rudi read a journal article about kidney transplants in cats.
sentences.ko: 루디는 고양이 신장 이식에 관한 학술지를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Rina membaca kisah pasien transplantasi hati yang kembali mendaki gunung.
sentences.en: Rina read the story of a liver transplant patient who went back to mountain climbing.
sentences.ko: 리나는 간이식 환자가 다시 산에 오르게 된 이야기를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Rudi selalu menyimpan serum penangkal bisa ular di lemari pendingin.
sentences.en: Rudi always keeps snake antivenom serum in the refrigerator.
sentences.ko: 루디는 늘 뱀독 해독 혈청을 냉장고에 보관해요.

sentences.text: Nenek Rina percaya daun sirih adalah penangkal masuk angin yang ampuh.
sentences.en: Rina's grandmother believes betel leaf is a powerful remedy against colds.
sentences.ko: 리나의 할머니는 구장 잎이 감기를 막는 데 아주 좋다고 믿어요.

sentences.text: Kuda itu terluka di bagian tumit, jadi Rudi membalutnya dengan hati-hati.
sentences.en: The horse was injured in the heel, so Rudi bandaged it carefully.
sentences.ko: 말이 뒤꿈치를 다쳐서 루디는 조심스럽게 붕대를 감았어요.

sentences.text: Sandal baru Rina terlalu keras sampai tumit kakinya lecet.
sentences.en: Rina's new sandals were so stiff that her heel got blistered.
sentences.ko: 리나의 새 샌들이 너무 딱딱해서 뒤꿈치가 까졌어요.

sentences.text: Rudi memperingatkan bahwa asap tembakau juga berbahaya bagi kucing di rumah.
sentences.en: Rudi warned that tobacco smoke is also harmful to cats at home.
sentences.ko: 루디는 담배 연기가 집 고양이에게도 해롭다고 경고했어요.

sentences.text: Banyak petani di desa Rina beralih dari tembakau ke kopi.
sentences.en: Many farmers in Rina's village have switched from tobacco to coffee.
sentences.ko: 리나네 마을의 많은 농부가 담배에서 커피로 작물을 바꿨어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menjelaskan cara mencegah overdosis obat cacing pada anak anjing.
sentences.en: Rudi explained how to prevent an overdose of deworming medicine in puppies.
sentences.ko: 루디는 강아지 구충제 과다 복용을 막는 방법을 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Penyuluh kesehatan mengingatkan warga desa Rina tentang bahaya overdosis obat warung.
sentences.en: The health educator reminded Rina's villagers about the danger of overdosing on over-the-counter drugs.
sentences.ko: 보건 교육 담당자는 리나네 마을 사람들에게 가게 약 과다 복용의 위험을 일깨웠어요.
